<thought>We need the retrosynthetic template that was found in the search result. The search returned a reaction_id of 150926, which is the identifier used in the template catalog. We'll retrieve the template with get_template using this ID, then apply it to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>get_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "template_id": "150926"
}
</action_input>
